$comment: The single source for every value shared across the Python/TypeScript boundary. frontend/src/generated/camera.ts is GENERATED from this file by evals/generate_camera_ts.py -- do not hand-edit the generated file. Plan 08 SS3.3.

source.rationale: The published egocentric capture contract. Evidence must show the complete FOV uncropped, so judge.py rejects a snapshot that does not carry it. Six hand-maintained copies before this file.
Uncropped source frame width. judge.py raises if a snapshot does not preserve it.
Uncropped source frame height. 1600x900 is exactly 16:9.

ego_neutral_gaze.unit: unit vector, application frame (Y-up, forward +Z), normalised at use

source.derived_from: the calibrated head pose of the mesh2motion VRM rig
source.rationale: Neutral egocentric gaze direction. The downward -0.65 component is the head's rest pitch, not a camera choice; both sides normalise before use, so the stored vector is deliberately un-normalised to keep the authored ratio legible.
Half-span used to decide whether the acting hand is fully inside the egocentric frame. Ported verbatim; no derivation is recorded anywhere in the repository.
